headline: Scenes cut from many takes now sync
highlights: A clip assembled from a dozen or more takes now syncs — a 2:51 assembly against a 22-minute source went from nothing placed to all of it placed, at 93% confidence
Matching is several times faster across the board: that same match takes 6.6 seconds where it took 49
Transcribe no longer crashes the app on Intel Macs
The stated requirement is now macOS 13.3 — the version the app has always actually needed
